newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Hong Kong jobless rate falls slightly to 2.8 pct.
newsitem.headline: Hong Kong jobless rate falls slightly to 2.8 pct.

text.p: Hong Kong's unemployment rate edged lower to 2.8 percent in the June to August period, compared with 2.9 percent in the May to July period, the Census and Statistics Department said on Monday.
The latest labour force statistics issued by the department showed that underemployment dropped to 1.4 percent in June to August, down from 1.6 percent in the previous period.
Labour market conditions continued to improve in recent months, a government spokesman said in a statement.
He said the seasonally adjusted unemployment rate had edged lower for four consecutive months.
For the period June to August 1996, decreases in the unemployment rate continued to occur in the manufacturing, wholesale and retail trades, and restaurants and hotels sectors.
The underemployment rate continued to fall in the manufacturing and construction sectors.
The unemployment and underemployment rates in the other major sectors remained generally stable, the spokesman said.
